description: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Transport - Aviation (Airports) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Customer Service. Airport is a facility, either on land or water, where aircraft can take off or land. It usually consists of hard-surfaced landing strips, a control tower, hangars, and accommodations for passengers and cargo. This data is held and maintained within the NSW Digital Topographic Database (DTDB) and includes key attributes such as airport name. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Customer Service. Its tags are Airports, Aviation, Geospatial, NSW Spatial Data Framework, Spatial Services. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
